definitions.explanation: a payment arrangement where each person pays for their own order rather than splitting evenly or one person paying

examples.japanese: {別会計|べつかいけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別会計|べつかいけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別会計|べつかいけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant doesn't allow separate checks.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate) + ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧ (bill, check)

RELATED PAYMENT EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧ - splitting the bill evenly
- {奢|おご}る / ⟦ご{馳走|ちそう}→ご馳走：01336_gochisou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to treat someone
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧{持|も}ち - paying for oneself
- ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ - to pay separately

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, asking for separate checks can sometimes be difficult at busy restaurants. The more common approach is for one person to pay and then settle up later, or to split evenly (⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧).
